steps.name: start-shizuku-and-check-phone-llm
steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
SEL='192.168.0.100:46769'
PKG='pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge'
adb start-server >/dev/null
adb connect "$SEL" >/dev/null
test "$(adb -s "$SEL" shell getprop ro.product.model | tr -d '\r')" = 'SM-S906B'
test "$(adb -s "$SEL" shell getprop ro.serialno | tr -d '\r')" = 'RFCT70L7E8J'
START=''
for P in /sdcard/Android/data/moe.shizuku.privileged.api/start.sh /storage/emulated/0/Android/data/moe.shizuku.privileged.api/start.sh; do
  if adb -s "$SEL" shell ls "$P" >/dev/null 2>&1; then START="$P"; break; fi
done
test -n "$START" || { echo 'shizuku_start_script_missing=true' >&2; exit 11; }
adb -s "$SEL" shell sh "$START"
sleep 3
adb -s "$SEL" shell ls -l /data/local/tmp/aicall-phone-llm/llama-server
adb -s "$SEL" shell ls -l /data/local/tmp/aicall-phone-llm/model-1.5b.gguf
echo 'phone_llm_runtime_files_present=true'
PYTHONPATH=scripts python3 -m aicall_tools.calls.live_call_readiness --serial "$SEL"
